# ThreadTales / Story Platform environment template
# Free local ThreadTales requires no account, secret, database, billing, AI, or telemetry.
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3000

# Optional PulseAtlas content-blind portfolio observability. SERVER-SIDE only.
PULSEATLAS_ENDPOINT=
PULSEATLAS_WRITE_KEY=
PULSEATLAS_ENVIRONMENT=production

# Stripe one-time ThreadTales premium.
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=
STRIPE_PRICE_THREADTALES_PREMIUM=
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=
ENTITLEMENT_SIGNING_SECRET=

# Story Platform recurring subscriptions. Amounts/prices are created in Stripe; code never invents pricing.
STRIPE_PRICE_PLUS_MONTHLY=
STRIPE_PRICE_PLUS_ANNUAL=
STRIPE_PRICE_FAMILY_MONTHLY=
STRIPE_PRICE_FAMILY_ANNUAL=
STRIPE_PRICE_CREATOR_MONTHLY=
STRIPE_PRICE_CREATOR_ANNUAL=
STRIPE_PRICE_BUSINESS_MONTHLY=
STRIPE_PRICE_BUSINESS_ANNUAL=

# Supabase Auth, account-backed worlds, private media, albums, music and telemetry.
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=
SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY=

# Optional OpenAI story enrichment. Server-only.
OPENAI_API_KEY=
OPENAI_STORY_MODEL=gpt-5.6-luna

# Optional external telemetry sink. Without this, configured Supabase is the safe sink.
TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT=
TELEMETRY_API_KEY=
